title: Inverse image of module sheaves is left adjoint to direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces, $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $Y$, $\mathcal M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules, and $\mathcal N$ a sheaf of $f^{-1}\mathcal A$-modules on $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f_p$, $f^{-1}=(f_p-)^\#$ with sheafification maps $\theta$, the unit $i$ of $f_p\dashv f_*$ on presheaves and the unit $\eta_{\mathcal A}=f_*(\theta_{\mathcal A})\circ i_{\mathcal A}:\mathcal A\to f_*f^{-1}\mathcal A$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. The inverse-image sheaf $f^{-1}\mathcal M$ is a sheaf of $f^{-1}\mathcal A$-modules: it is the sheafification of the presheaf of $f_p\mathcal A$-modules $f_p\mathcal M$ of [lem-pc-presheaf-module-inverse-image-adjunction] (1), with the $f^{-1}\mathcal A=(f_p\mathcal A)^\#$-module structure of [lem-pc-presheaf-module-sheafification-ring], the one for which $\theta_{\mathcal M}:f_p\mathcal M\to f^{-1}\mathcal M$ is semilinear over $\theta_{\mathcal A}$. The direct-image sheaf $f_*\mathcal N$, whose sections over $V\subseteq Y$ are $\mathcal N(f^{-1}V)$, is an $\mathcal A$-module through $\eta_{\mathcal A}$ ($a\in\mathcal A(V)$ acts by $\eta_{\mathcal A,V}(a)\in f^{-1}\mathcal A(f^{-1}V)$). Then the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Ab}(X)}(f^{-1}\mathcal M,\mathcal N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Ab}(Y)}(\mathcal M,f_*\mathcal N)$ of abelian sheaves restricts to a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{f^{-1}\mathcal A}(f^{-1}\mathcal M,\mathcal N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal M,f_*\mathcal N)$, natural in $\mathcal M$ and $\mathcal N$.

proof.text: Use the abelian sheaf adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. For a linear map psi from the canonical inverse-image module to N, its adjunct is psi composed with eta_M on sections. The semilinearity of eta_M from [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module] and the linearity of psi show that this adjunct is linear for the A-action on f_*N through eta_A. Construct this module morphism with PresheafOfModules.homMk.

For an A-linear map g:M -> f_*N, let q be its inverse adjunct as an abelian sheaf map. The adjunction identity says q(eta_M(m)) = g(m). Compare the operations (r,m) -> q(r*m) and (r,m) -> r*q(m) on inverse-image sections. Both commute with restriction by naturality of q and the semilinear restriction laws of the canonical inverse-image module and of N. On pairs of unit images they agree: q(eta_A(a)*eta_M(m)) = q(eta_M(a*m)) = g(a*m) = eta_A(a)*g(m) = eta_A(a)*q(eta_M(m)). Apply [lem-pc-inverse-image-operation-ext] to conclude that q is linear on all sections. This covers empty opens as well, since that theorem has no nonemptiness hypothesis.

The forward linear map is injective because forgetting to abelian sheaves is faithful and the abelian Hom equivalence is injective. Step 2 gives surjectivity using the inverse of that equivalence. Form Equiv.ofBijective. Its section formula is the defining formula of the abelian Hom equivalence. Apply the left and right naturality identities of the abelian adjunction and faithfulness of the forgetful functor to prove both required module naturality identities. The inverse-image map is the underlying abelian inverse-image map by [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module], and pushforward acts sectionwise by [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image].
